purpose: Define a 100-chapter arc plan with stage goals, commercial peaks, and map-change conditions.

1_10.stage_goal: establish premise, conflict, and reader commitment
1_10.checkpoint: clear protagonist goal, clear pressure, clear continuing hook

11_20.stage_goal: expand conflict field and sharpen relationships
11_20.checkpoint: reliable conflict escalation and character differentiation

21_30.stage_goal: deliver first major payoff and commit to the larger track

31_40.stage_goal: raise stakes and test the protagonist under pressure
31_40.checkpoint: new pressure source and new consequence

41_50.stage_goal: force a choice and redirect the arc

51_60.stage_goal: open the next layer of conflict
51_60.checkpoint: new enemy / new constraint / new reveal

61_70.checkpoint: visible progress toward the larger promise

81_90.stage_goal: approach the next climax and consolidate gains

91_100.stage_goal: deliver climax and set up the next long arc

next_actions: write stage goals into the generation chain as objectives
tag chapter groups with checkpoint metadata
